title: Working on the next level of my bounty game: Wanted
author: Lumpy_Conference6640
selftext:
Wanted is a bounty game that uses a engine system I designed in conjunction with AI. The goal of which is to build a AI friendly game structure.

It's reinventing the wheel, but right now we're straping a engine and wherls on to a horse and fighting that uphill battle. 

The underlying structure is pretty familiar three.js, Vite, and python. 

But it uses a slice based system for our themeatic strands. 

As a result, and pull out, remove and rebuild the whole system with, or without AI, with a low code, no code editor tool. 

My apologies screenshots are coming, I'm usually making these posts at night when I don't have all of my stuff available short a couple of odd shots. 

The above picture is what I'm using to build the new volumetric shading and environmental weather systems for lighting and vibe. Assets are already in place and I built them in Meshy.ai. UI upgrades are coming soon.
